title: Anomaly Flow II: Estimates and Long-time Existence for the Coupled Flow
summary: In this follow-up to \cite{Sua25}, we extend the results to the coupled anomaly flow which incorporates the evolution of a Hermitian metric on a holomorphic vector bundle over a compact complex $3$-fold with general slope parameter $α'$. This yields a similar sufficient smallness condition on the slope parameter $α'$ in order to extend the flow on $[0, τ)$ to $[0, τ+ ε)$. We also augment the argument of \cite{Sua25} slightly to fix the peculiarity of the units in the condition for $α'$ for the $k = 1$ case.
